# Sabotage: Ecliptic Scanners on <Planet>

*duo_delve20a · by jessica*

**Briefing:** The Ecliptic have a scanner array at the <Place> watching everything that moves on <Planet>. The settlers who posted the job don't want it broken. They want it lying.

**Where:** a quiet, non-hostile site, never caves.

📻 **Settler, on the radio:**
> You took our job? Good. Remember, don't break anything. A broken scanner gets fixed. A scanner that's wrong gets believed.

## 1. USE · the centre of the site

🎯 Feed false readings to the Ecliptic scanners at the <Place>

🧱 Object: Ecliptic Motion Scanner · SeismicSensor01.nif
